target_customer: Collectors and sellers of trading cards and diecast in Brazil (originally secondhand fashion buyers and sellers)
problem: Collectors lack a trusted live venue to see items, ask questions and buy; sellers lack an audience.
business_model: marketplace take rate on live shopping sales

founders.name: Louis de Jenlis
previous_startups: Online vintage shop with Aymar Dumoulin (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Aymar Dumoulin
previous_startups: Online vintage shop with Louis de Jenlis (outcome not stated)

competitors.name: Shopee Live (Brazil)
competitors.what: Live commerce feature inside Shopee marketplace app
competitors.traction_then: Launched in Brazil 2022-03-15; scale not stated at launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Live video, chat, checkout and local payments (PIX) in a mobile app is standard but multi part engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Seller and buyer communities could create liquidity in a niche, but large marketplaces can add live features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Shopee launched live commerce in Brazil in March 2022; Mercado Livre launched its live tool on 2026-08-31 per a search result.

market_need_then: Brazilian press in 2023 described live shopping as a coming channel; Shopee's 2022 launch shows platform demand. Collectibles demand evidence is from 2026 reports.

branding.community_and_virality: Collector community of TCG players is emphasized in app listings (2026).

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name; app listings stress community, but no independent brand coverage found. Company website returned HTTP 429 and was not worked around.

pivots.to: Live shopping for collectibles in Brazil
pivots.why: Brazilian press describes Brazil as priority market with collectibles niche; exact date not given (reported 2026)

outcome_analysis: Jamble is active and has focused on collectibles in Brazil, reporting over 3,000 active buyers and 400 sellers in a few months of operation in a 2026 article, and R$4 million of April sales in another headline. Funding found is small and from aggregators only. It moved from a French secondhand fashion live app to a niche where platform rivals are less specialized.
notes: Company website https://www.jamble.com/ returned HTTP 429, not retried elsewhere. Funding unverified: CB Insights shows a $0.5M convertible note 2022-09-09 and $500K over 3 rounds; investors listed include YC, Pioneer Fund, Fundamental Ventures, Goodwater Capital. Headquarters conflicts (Paris, San Francisco, Georgia).
